name: Vancouver Island
about: Summer (Jul–Aug) has the driest, sunniest weather and the best orca watching; winter (Nov–Feb) is genuinely the rainiest stretch of the year, though it's also Tofino's famous storm-watching season.
overview: Tofino's surfing and storm watching, ancient rainforest, Victoria's colonial charm and Butchart Gardens — Canada's Pacific coast at its wildest.
costOverview: Victoria and Tofino both stay reasonable for casual food — orca watching tours and Tofino's surf lessons and storm-watching lodges are the real splurges.

specialSeasons.text: Tofino's 'storm watching' season — cozying up to watch dramatic Pacific storms roll in — is a genuine, if niche, winter draw despite being the rainiest stretch of the year.
